headline: Fenglope double jump
title: Fenglope | A Mount With Double Jump | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a mount that double jumps? Fenglope can be ridden in Palworld one point zero, and its partner skill, Wind and Clouds, lets you double jump while mounted. Find it around the Number Three Wildlife Sanctuary at roughly level forty five to fifty. At your base it works Lumbering level three. Will you ride Fenglope? Comment below!
description: Fenglope in Palworld 1.0: a rideable Pal with a double jump partner skill, found at the No. 3 Wildlife Sanctuary around level 45 to 50.
